title: Sinar Karangkraf Media Kit 2025/26 — Sinar Harian, SinarPlus, Bestari & Daily
summary: Sinar Harian print from RM2,240 (quarter page B&W); full page colour RM16,960; digital CPM RM30–90; Sinar Daily article RM8k.
description: Sinar Karangkraf media kit 2025/26 (38 pages) covering Sinar Harian and Sinar Ahad, SinarPlus, Sinar Bestari and Sinar Daily. Sinar Harian print: full page B&W RM8,960 / colour RM16,960, half page RM4,480 / RM12,480, quarter page RM2,240 / RM10,240, double page RM26,880 / RM42,480, front-page bottom panel RM19,360, ear space RM21,250, full wrap RM200,000; classified liners RM18–35 per line by frequency. Digital display CPM RM30–90, masthead RM10,000/day, branded advertorial RM8,000–14,000, social posts from RM500, Facebook Live RM5,000, TikTok from RM4,000. SinarPlus and Sinar Bestari digital from RM2,000/week; Sinar Daily display RM8,000–15,000/week and mobile app RM5,000–12,000. Video/programme sponsorships from RM10,000. Rates exclude SST and include 15% agency commission.
validity: 2025–2026 media kit; T&C state rates valid 1 Jan–31 Dec 2025
